LiCida legt deine Vorlage über das Kamer: LiCida lays your template over the camera image of your paper, and you trace the lines. For Android, designed following Apple’s guidelines. The app has no internet access and no purchases.
Eine Camera lucida spiegelt das Motiv au: A camera lucida reflects the subject onto your paper. Painters have used it to transfer outlines for over 200 years. LiCida does the same with your phone’s camera. It is modeled on the iOS app “Camera Lucida”, rebuilt for Android and designed following Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines.
Stell das Handy mit der Kamera nach unte: Place the phone firmly above the paper with the camera facing down, for example on a holder, a tripod or a stack of books.
Camera and template are now linked. You can zoom up to 30×, focus and lock the exposure while you trace.
Eine schwarze Fläche mit schwebenden Gla: A black surface with floating glass buttons, laid out like the Camera app. Nothing distracts you while drawing.
Eine Sitzung merkt sich Vorlage, Filter,: A session remembers the template, filters, position, camera and alignment, plus a snapshot of your sheet.
Im Projektor-Modus bleibt das Kamerabild: In projector mode the camera image stays black and only the template lights up. A Bluetooth keyboard, a controller or a selfie remote controls zoom, opacity and flicker while you stand at the wall.
Alle Funktionen sind enthalten. Es gibt: All features are included. There are no in-app purchases.
Graustufen, Tontrennung, Lasurwerte, Com: Grayscale, posterize, glaze values, comic, neon, edges, threshold, grid and corner marks. Plus a history and three custom sequences.
Fasst die Vorlage zu wenigen Farben zusa: Reduces the template to a few colors. While drawing, you hide one color after another, for painting by colors for example.
Druck das Zielbild aus, leg es hin und t: Print the target image, lay it down and tap. LiCida then straightens the camera image as if the camera were looking straight down.
Aus einer Stunde Zeichnen wird eine Minu: An hour of drawing becomes a minute of video. Android’s own encoder puts it straight into your photos.
Links die Vorlage, rechts das Papier. Od: Template on the left, paper on the right. Or the template fades in and out: when the color matches, the flicker disappears.
Beim ersten Start zeigt ein Rundgang jed: On first launch, a tour shows every button. The German guide is in the app and available as a PDF to print.
LiCida sieht nur das eine Bild, das du a: LiCida sees only the one picture you choose and the camera image. The app has no internet access, so it cannot send anything.
Kostenlos, Version 0.2 Beta für Android: Free, version 0.2 beta for Android 10 and later.
Der vollständige Quelltext und alle Vers: The complete source code and all versions. You can report bugs and ideas in the issue tracker.
